name: Flycastrophe
summary: A faster, rougher Flycast for Dreamcast, Naomi and Atomiswave.
description: Adds Flycastrophe as an emulator you can choose for Dreamcast, Naomi and Atomiswave games. It is Flycast's libretro core with speed changes from Deadcast ported in, and it trades some accuracy for speed. There is no app to open: after installing, pick Flycastrophe as the emulator for a system or a single game.
author: Helaas
